def: CHECK (((queue_stage)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Registered'::character varying, 'Scheduled'::character varying, 'Arrived'::character varying, 'Payment Pending'::character varying, 'Prep Pending'::character varying, 'Ready for Exam'::character varying, 'In Exam'::character varying, 'Reporting'::character varying, 'Finalized'::character varying, 'Delivered'::character varying, 'Cancelled'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((((is_follow_up = true) AND (prior_exam_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((is_follow_up = false) AND (prior_exam_id IS NULL))) AND (prior_exam_id IS DISTINCT FROM exam_id)))
FOREIGN KEY (prior_exam_id) REFERENCES examinations(exam_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((pregnancy_safety_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Unknown'::character varying, 'Cleared'::character varying, 'At Risk'::character varying, 'Not Applicable'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((implant_safety_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Unknown'::character varying, 'Cleared'::character varying, 'At Risk'::character varying, 'Not Applicable'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((renal_safety_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Unknown'::character varying, 'Cleared'::character varying, 'At Risk'::character varying, 'Not Applicable'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((current_station)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Reception'::character varying, 'Cashier'::character varying, 'Nurse'::character varying, 'Modality'::character varying, 'Radiologist'::character varying, 'Delivery'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((report_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Draft'::character varying, 'Typed'::character varying, 'Reviewed'::character varying, 'Approved'::character varying, 'Amended'::character varying, 'Finalized'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (template_id) REFERENCES report_templates(template_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
